name: Pastel retro sci-fi
description: Flat retro-futurist illustration: astronauts, hover-ships, brutalist towers and small figures under pink, orange and teal skies, a big sun or moon.
light: flat warm sunset or bright midday, colour blocks instead of shading
composition: simple and graphic, one figure or vehicle against large flat sky, strong horizon, lots of negative space
camera_or_medium: flat digital illustration with risograph grain, 70s and 80s anime and paperback feel
mood: dreamy, nostalgic, calm, a little lonely
texture_detail: flat colour fields, fine grain, thin line accents, no gradients except the sky
subjects: an astronaut sitting on a pink dune at sunset
a yellow hover-train between brutalist towers
a girl with headphones on a rooftop under a big moon
friends in matching jackets watching a ship land
